decisions.reason: As a door lever handle family close to the core range and still shown after launch, it fits the firm's broad established portfolio, so management is likely to continue backing it rather than admit a failed line.

This door handle design remains close to the firm's core offer and visible after launch, and in a growing industry management can plausibly attribute any weaker performance to temporary market mix rather than withdraw it quickly.

The electronic access system has high development content, explicit public launch claims, and strong alignment with the firm's stated move toward digital building organization, which makes management especially likely to persist with it.
